p1: 2 a.m., camping. My brother Ben yelled for me from the trees.
Ben's called me mate since we were kids. Never Sam.
I reached for the tent zip. A hand grabbed my wrist.
It was Ben. In his sleeping bag beside me, shaking. He whispered,
Sam, don't go. I heard it too.
We lay there in the dark. Barely breathing.
It came closer, circling the tent. Crying.
Then the thing holding my wrist whispered, in Ben's voice...
Next morning, Ben calls me mate again. He smiles a lot.
